summary: Show the birds heard by BirdNET-Go on your Mac or Linux computer. Needs your computer.
page_description: See the birds BirdNET-Go hears on your computer, drawn as Fugleramme's labelled plates and sent to your Kobo. The last collage stays on screen offline.
release_notes: Asks the reader to stay awake while the birds are on screen, and says so in the menu when the reader cannot.

steps.text: Birds needs BirdNET-Go and Fugleramme running on a Mac or Linux computer with a microphone. Install and start both first, as the Birds README describes.
Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
Start sending what BirdNET-Go hears to the reader. It checks the station and the reader first, and says what to fix if either does not answer.
